title: Design Spotify Music Streaming
description: Model songs, playlists, artists, albums, and playback.

data.text: Design a music streaming service like Spotify. Users browse songs, create playlists, follow artists, and play music with shuffle and repeat.

data.title: Song, Playlist, and PlaybackService
Why Queue for playback?
data.text: A queue naturally models playlists and shuffle. Dequeue gives the next song in O(1). Enqueue adds to the end. For shuffle, randomize the queue upfront.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Song is the core catalog entity
PlaybackService uses a queue for next-song logic
data.takeaway: Music streaming is a queue and catalog problem. Playback is a queue. Discovery is a graph of artists, albums, and genres.
